label: Palace exam preparation events
summary: Picks one random event for a character taking part in the palace examination phase of an imperial examination.
details: Script fires it, not the game's code, and the root is a character. It only runs while the activity (saved as scope:activity) is in its palace examination phase. The pool mixes emperor events (a feast, a gift, a recital) with entrant events (consolation from the examiner, an old entrant, a disappointed relative), all with the same weight of 100.

label: Auspicious birthright birth
summary: Runs for a newborn child (scope:child) when the mother or the real father has the personal tenet flag mystical_birthright_spiritual_leader, and may give the child a trait.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It uses scope:child and scope:mother, and scope:real_father when there is one. A comment says the base chance is 5 percent for later children, and the first-child modifiers shift it to 20 percent. Vanilla uses it to give a trait such as dwarf or giant. The definition in the input is cut off, so the rest of the outcomes are not covered.

label: Cathedral founder events
summary: Picks one random event for the founder of a cathedral great project.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. Vanilla lists four events (pam_great_projects_events 0007, 0008, 0011 and 0013), each equally likely. The yearly cathedral on_action schedules it for the founder five years later.

label: Cathedral yearly check
summary: Goes through every great project of type pam_cathedral_02 or pam_cathedral_03 and schedules later events for its founder and its owner.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. For each such project, the founder gets the founder events on_action in 5 years and the owner gets the owner events on_action, in 10 years if the owner is also the founder and in 5 years otherwise. The founder is saved as scope:founder. A comment says the first tier is paced once when pam_cathedral_01 starts building (2 years).

label: Cathedral owner events
summary: Fires the one cathedral event meant for the owner of a cathedral great project.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. Vanilla lists a single entry, pam_great_projects_events.0012, in a random list, so that event is the only choice.

label: Christian yearly events
summary: Picks a yearly random event for Christian characters, mostly religious flavour for rulers, clergy and theocrats.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. It needs the character to pass the secular faith clergy check, be of the Christian religion and not have the flag recently_got_pam_christian_event. Theocracies, scholars and mystics get a higher weight and cynical or low-zeal characters a lower one. The pool holds a large weight (200) for no event at all, plus theocratic ruler, religious artifact, generic and secular faith events. The definition in the input is cut off.

label: Dulia sainthood variable
summary: Sets the dead-character variable pam_dulia_personal_sainthood with a duration of 100 years.
details: Script fires it, and it has no fixed root. Its only effect is set_dead_character_variable with years = 100. The input does not show what reads the variable.

label: Council doctrine debate events
summary: Picks a random 'Sway ...' event for a character during the doctrine debate phase of an ecumenical council.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. A human player must be the council host or a valid voter. For AI characters the host, the faith's religious head or an active counterplayer qualifies. The events are the 'Sway ...' events (ecumenical_council_events 0101 to 0129), weighted 25 or 50.

label: Council tenet debate events
summary: Picks a random 'Sway ...' event for a character during the tenet debate phase of an ecumenical council.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. The conditions and the event list are the same as in the doctrine debate on_action, down to the same 'Sway ...' events. Only the phase named in the comment differs.

label: Mountain travel fulfillment
summary: Rewards a traveller with piety and spiritual fulfillment once per journey when the trip passes through mountains.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. The character must have the personal tenet flag cthonic_redoubts_mountain_travel_fulfillment and be in a mountains or desert mountains location on their travel plan. The plan is marked with a variable so the reward comes only once. The reward is minor piety and minor spiritual fulfillment, shown in a toast.

label: Tenet change fulfillment update
summary: Runs the personal tenet fulfillment update for every character of a faith when tenets were added, removed or changed.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It only runs if the lists changed_tenet_status, added_tenets or removed_tenets hold at least one entry. Then every character of the root's faith runs pam_personal_tenet_rite_update_fulfillment_effect. What that effect does is not shown in this input.

label: Sainthood word variable
summary: Sets the dead-character variable pam_propagate_word_of_my_sainthood with a duration of 100 years.
details: Script fires it, and it has no fixed root. Its only effect is set_dead_character_variable with years = 100. The input does not show what reads the variable.

label: Wilderness building completed
summary: Removes the preserved wilderness modifier from a province when a building is finished there, if the province has a holding.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It does nothing before the game has started (global variable game_has_started), because a comment says adding a great building fires the completion on_action during history setup. Otherwise, if the province has a holding and the modifier preserved_wilderness_modifier, the modifier is removed.

label: Wilderness travel check
summary: While a character travels, adds or removes a travel plan modifier depending on preserved wilderness, and rewards visiting new wilderness.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. When the travel plan's current location has the preserved_wilderness_modifier, the plan gets the travel plan modifier preserved_wilderness_travel_modifier. If the plan has it and the location no longer does, the plan loses it. A character with the tenet flag tenet_sanctity_of_nature_wilderness_fulfillment who stands at a location without a holding that is not a sea province, and that is not yet in the plan's visited list, gets a miniscule amount of spiritual fulfillment, and the place is added to that list.

label: Faith study acceptance
summary: Raises the owner's culture's acceptance of the target's culture, if the owner has the matching personal tenet and a different culture.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It needs scope:owner and scope:target. The owner must have the personal tenet flag adaptive_study_rite_cultural_acceptance and a culture different from the target's. The owner's culture then gains a minor amount of cultural acceptance toward the target's culture, and a toast is shown to the owner.

label: Conversion fulfillment (tax tenet)
summary: Runs the tax-nonbelievers conversion fulfillment effect for scope:actor, if the actor holds the matching personal tenet.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It needs scope:actor to exist, be a different person from the root, and have the personal tenet flag tax_nonbelievers_fulfillment_from_conversion. Then the actor runs pam_tax_nonbelievers_conversion_fulfillment_effect. What that effect hands out is not shown in this input, and neither is who converts.

label: Christian Church yearly checks
summary: Runs three catalyst effects for the Christian Church; going by its name, once a year.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. The effects follow comments in vanilla: a non-Christian kingdom in Europe, a non-Catholic ruler holding the Papal State's de jure capital, and a non-Christian Byzantine emperor. What each catalyst does is inside those named effects, not shown here.

label: Parent meddling outcome
summary: Picks a random event about a living parent meddling in the character's life.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. It only runs if scope:parent is alive. The events are equally likely: the parent sends a child away to be educated, insults a courtier, causes stress, or takes interest in the character's child.

label: Party Baron events
summary: Picks a random event from the Party Baron story cycle, with a 70 percent chance that anything fires.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. The events cover the Party Baron helping, befriending, protecting or bringing volunteers, and the ruler's vassals reacting to him. Some have a weight of 100, some 200 or 300.

label: Patronage setup
summary: Picks a random on_action for the councillor spouse's tasks, most likely the patronage task.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. A chance_to_happen of spouse_on_action_setup_chance applies. AI rulers have a chance of nothing happening that rises as their title gets lower (30, 70 or 95). The pool is weighted: patronage task 100, and court politics, chivalry, manage domain and court intrigue tasks 20 each.

label: Patronage task events
summary: Picks a random event from the councillor spouse's patronage task.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. It needs the character's spouse councillor to be the councillor saved as scope:councillor. The pool has a weight of 300 for no event, then events grouped by different faith or culture, same faith or culture, and general ones, such as opinion gains, piety, tutoring and helping with focus progress.

label: Pay homage invalid
summary: Fires the pay homage events 0009 and 0601 for a character; going by its name, when a homage can no longer go ahead.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. Vanilla lists both events directly in an events block, so both fire, not one of them. Vanilla does not say here why the homage became invalid.

label: Pay homage start
summary: Sets up a character's pay homage when it starts: stress for shy or arrogant characters, a grace marker, and the liege's cooldown.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. Shy or arrogant characters get minor stress. The character stores their liege in the variable pay_homage_grace, and the liege gets a pay_homage_cooldown of 2 years to stop AI vassals paying homage all at once. It also reads the variable homage_type and, for the contract type, sets pay_homage_contract_type to 0 (levies) or 1 (gold). The definition in the input is cut off, so the rest is not covered.

label: Pay homage cancelled
summary: Refunds the costs and clears the stored data when a character leaves the pay homage travel planner.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It removes the grace variable if it points at the liege, refunds the prestige cost and any gold paid, and shows a toast. Shy or arrogant characters lose a medium amount of stress (the start on_action added a minor amount). Then it removes the variables homage_type, pay_homage_contract_type, homage_liege_scope and pay_homage_gold_value.

label: Peasant affair, looking
summary: Fires the first usable of two peasant affair events, peasant_affair.2001 then peasant_affair.2002.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. Vanilla uses first_valid, so the game tries the events in order and runs the first one that can fire. The input does not describe what the events are about.

label: Peasant affair, at court
summary: Picks a random peasant affair event, with only a 25 percent chance that anything fires.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. The pool has a weight of 500 for no event. The events, going by vanilla's comments, are the peasant mother or father asking to have the child acknowledged, the peasant asking to become a lover, or to marry the character.

label: Peasant affair, shows up
summary: Fires the peasant affair event peasant_affair.1001.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. Vanilla lists a single entry in a random list, so that event is the only choice. The input does not describe the event itself.

label: Ceremonial liege petition ghosted
summary: Fires event petition_liege.0009 if the character still has a ceremonial liege petition marker.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. The check is for the variable petition_ceremonial_liege_scope. The name suggests the petition was left unanswered, but the input does not say when it fires.

label: Ceremonial liege petition start
summary: Sets up a petition to a ceremonial liege: raises a flag, stores the liege and stresses shy or arrogant characters.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It needs scope:ceremonial_liege. The character gets the flag petition_ceremonial_liege_character_flag and the variable petition_ceremonial_liege_scope holding that liege. Shy or arrogant characters gain a medium amount of stress.

label: Ceremonial liege petition cancelled
summary: Refunds the costs and clears the markers when a ceremonial liege petition trip is left.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It removes the decision cooldown for petition_ceremonial_liege_decision and refunds the activity cost, as influence for characters who pass petition_liege_admin_valid_trigger and as prestige otherwise. A toast tells the player. It also clears the variables petition_liege_scope and petition_type and the flag petition_liege_character_flag if present. Those names belong to the plain liege petition, not the ceremonial one, which looks odd.

label: Petition head of faith start
summary: Activates the pending petition to the head of the faith.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It runs the effect petition_head_of_faith_activate_pending_effect, whose contents are not shown in this input.

label: Petition head of faith cancelled
summary: Cleans up and refunds the reserved piety when a petition trip to the head of the faith is cancelled.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It only runs if the character has the variable pending_petition_head_of_faith_recipient. It refunds pending or reserved piety with a toast, clears the pending state, and runs the cleanup effect if the petition character flag is set. A comment says an earlier event may already have refunded, in which case the reserved value is gone and the refund is skipped.

label: Petition liege, step 0101
summary: Fires event petition_liege.0101 if the liege and the vassal are still alive and free, and event petition_liege.0601 otherwise.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It needs scope:petition_liege and scope:petition_vassal. Both must be alive and not imprisoned. Both events are triggered on the character the on_action runs on.

label: Petition liege, step 0201
summary: Fires event petition_liege.0201 for the petitioning vassal if the petition is still valid, and event petition_liege.0601 otherwise.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. Validity is checked with petition_liege_valid_trigger. The 0201 event goes to scope:petition_vassal, and 0601 goes to the character the on_action runs on.

label: Petition liege, counter offer
summary: Fires event petition_liege.0205, the liege's counter offer, if the petition is still valid, and event petition_liege.0601 otherwise.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. Validity is checked with petition_liege_valid_trigger. A comment in vanilla says the liege proposes a counter offer.

label: Petition liege, skill check
summary: Fires event petition_liege.0401, the vassal's skill check, if the petition is still valid, and event petition_liege.0601 otherwise.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. Validity is checked with petition_liege_valid_trigger. A comment in vanilla calls event 0401 the vassal skill check event.

label: Liege petition ghosted
summary: Fires event petition_liege.0009 if the character still has a liege petition marker.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. The check is for the variable petition_liege_scope. The name suggests the petition was left unanswered, but the input does not say when it fires.

label: Petition liege start
summary: Sets up a petition to the liege: raises a flag, stores the liege and stresses shy or arrogant characters.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. The character gets the flag petition_liege_character_flag and the variable petition_liege_scope holding their liege. Shy or arrogant characters gain a medium amount of stress. A comment says it comes from the activity rework.

label: Petition liege cancelled
summary: Refunds the costs and clears the markers when a petition to the liege trip is left.
details: Script fires it and the game gives no fixed root. It removes the decision cooldown of petition_liege_decision and refunds the activity cost, as influence for characters who pass petition_liege_admin_valid_trigger and as prestige otherwise. A toast tells the player. It also clears the variables petition_liege_scope and petition_type and the flag petition_liege_character_flag if present.

label: Repeatable murder intercept
summary: Picks a random event that stops a murder attempt through a protection that is not used up or is easily replaced.
details: Script fires it, with a character as root. A comment says these are methods that are not used up during their event or can easily be replaced, like bodyguards. The event comments name a Varangian, a personal guard, a food taster, a cup-bearer, a gluttonous trait, a bodyguard and a shieldmaiden. Weights run from 5 to 600.
